label: PROSITE / HAMAP Domain Signatures
description: For a pathway's UniProt-accession enzymes, federates to UniProt's own SPARQL endpoint to list the PROSITE pattern/profile and HAMAP family signature identifiers (rdfs:seeAlso) attached to each protein. LIMITATION (checked live, both still true as of writing): neither PROSITE nor HAMAP currently exposes a reachable public SPARQL endpoint of their own (purl.expasy.org/prosite/signature/<id> resolves to an HTML page only; HAMAP's documented endpoint, hamap.expasy.org/sparql[/sparql], 404s on every URL pattern tried), so this query can only surface the bare signature id via UniProt — not the signature's name/description, which would need a second federated hop that isn't available right now.
